lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A structured grid of high-luminance circular spots is visible posterior to the branchial region, arranged in roughly four horizontal rows that follow the longitudinal body axis.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect the horizontal rows of white spots, creating a lattice-like visual structure across the mid-flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three prominent longitudinal ridges are visible on the dorsal-lateral surface, defined by high-intensity upper edges and dark shadowed lower edges running parallel to the spine.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The first dorsal fin exhibits approximately seven distinct, high-intensity circular spots distributed unevenly across its visible lateral silhouette.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Multiple long, linear white striations of high pixel intensity are visible crossing the mid-lateral flank diagonally, consistent with healed abrasive trauma.
other_distinctive_markers: The pectoral fin shows a high density of smaller, lower-intensity spots toward its distal edge, and several commensal organisms (Echeneidae) are visible near the ventral surface.
